 The Livermore Evaluated Photon Data Library (EPDL97) in the       100 1451   11
 ENDF/B-VI format                                                  100 1451   12

  27/502   Coherent scattering form factors                        100 1451   27

 ================================================================= 100 1451   31
  Warning                                                          100 1451   32
 ================================================================= 100 1451   33
  MF/MT combinations used to define photoionization subshell cross 100 1451   34
  sections (MF=23, MT=534-572) and coherent anomalous scattering   100 1451   35
  factors (MF=27, MT=505 AND 506) are newly defined MF/MT numbers  100 1451   36
  for ENDF/B-VI that did not exist in earlier versions of ENDF/B.  100 1451   37
  If you are not prepared to use this data you need merely delete  100 1451   38
  it and all of the remaining data will still be consistent and    100 1451   39
  equivalent to the types of data in earlier versions of ENDF/B.   100 1451   40
  However, this will limit the range of problems to which this     100 1451   41
  data can be applied (see: ref. 1 for details).                   100 1451   42
 ================================================================= 100 1451   43
  Definition of new types of data                                  100 1451   44
 ================================================================= 100 1451   45
  1) The total photoionization cross section is equal to the sum   100 1451   46
     of the photoionization subshell cross sections.               100 1451   47
                                                                   100 1451   48
     For each subshell on the second line of a section the C1 and  100 1451   49
     C2 fields are defined as,                                     100 1451   50
                                                                   100 1451   51
     EPE = The photoionization edge energy (similar to Q-value)    100 1451   52
     EFL = The fluorescence yield (eV/photoionization)             100 1451   53
                                                                   100 1451   54
  2) The angular distribution of coherently scattered photons is,  100 1451   55
                                                                   100 1451   56
     S(E,MU) = 3*T/8*(1 + MU**2)*((FF(M)+F1(E))**2+(F2(E))**2)     100 1451   57
                                                                   100 1451   58
     S(E,MU) = Angular distributions (barns per unit cosine)       100 1451   59
     T       = The Thomson cross section                           100 1451   60
     MU      = The cosine of the scattering angle                  100 1451   61
     FF(M)   = The atomic form factor                              100 1451   62
     M       = Momentum transfer = SIN(THETA/2)/LAMBDA/4*PI        100 1451   63
     F1(E)   = The real anomalous scattering factor                100 1451   64
     F2(E)   = The imaginary anomalous scattering factor           100 1451   65
                                                                   100 1451   66
     F1(E) and F2(E) are isotropic.                                100 1451   67
                                                                   100 1451   68
     When F1(E) = F2(E) = 0 this reduces to the result obtained    100 1451   69
     using only form factors (the older ENDF/B convention).        100 1451   70
 ================================================================= 100 1451   71
 Differences between EPDL97 and the data base presented here       100 1451   72
 ================================================================= 100 1451   73
 1) Energy range - EPDL97 - 1 eV to 100 GeV                        100 1451   74
                   Here   - 1 eV TO 100 GeV (previously 100 MeV)   100 1451   75
 2) Type of Data - EPDL97 - Photon interaction including           100 1451   76
                            photoexcitation                        100 1451   77
                   Here   - Photon interaction  - ENDF/B-VI has    100 1451   78
                            no provision for photoexcitation       100 1451   79
 3) Secondary E  - EPDL97 - Average energy of each secondary       100 1451   80
                            (photons, electrons, positrons)        100 1451   81
                   HERE   - No secondary energy data               100 1451   82
 4) Interpolation- EPDL97 - Cross sections are Log X vs. Log Y     100 1451   83
                            interpolable - the total cross         100 1451   84
                            section is not included                100 1451   85
                          - Form factors and scattering functions  100 1451   86
                            are Log X vs. Log y, except first      100 1451   87
                            interval.                              100 1451   88
                          - Anomalous scattering factors linearly  100 1451   89
                            interpolable (they can be negative)    100 1451   90
                   Here   - Up through ENDF/B-V photon interaction 100 1451   91
                            cross sections were Log X vs. Log Y.   100 1451   92
                          - For the first two Mods. of ENDF/B-VI   100 1451   93
                            in order to consistently define the    100 1451   94
                            total cross sections at ALL energies   100 1451   95
                            all cross sections were linearized.    100 1451   96
                            This was NOT a good idea.              100 1451   97
                          - Starting with Mod. 3, cross sections   100 1451   98
                            are left in Log X vs. Log. Y form so   100 1451   99
                            that they are IDENTICAL to what's in   100 1451  100
                            EPDL97.                                100 1451  101
                            The total is defined ONLY at the       100 1451  102
                            energies tabulated in any other cross  100 1451  103
                            section.                               100 1451  104
                 WARNING  - As a result the total cross section    100 1451  105
                            MUST NOT be interpolated to define the 100 1451  106
                            total between tabulated energies. The  100 1451  107
                            ONLY consist way to define the total   100 1451  108
                            between tabulated energies is to       100 1451  109
                            interpolate all of the partials and    100 1451  110
                            add them up.                           100 1451  111
